cards.title: Guiyang → Libo → Anshun
cards.sub: Four days, two big sights, zero 20,000-step days.

days.note: Land, 20 min to town. Qingyun market at 7pm — skewers, snacks, fridge magnets.
11:50 train, ¥10 shuttle to the gate. East in, bus to West, walk down: Wolong Pool → Cuigu → Laya → exit.
¥22 bus from the station. Straight to the big waterfall, walk down, lift back up. Get off at Visitor Centre 2.
Bean hotpot for lunch, then fly out. No alarm.

cards.foot: Save the route, skip the stairs.

cards.title: Hailar → Ergun → Moerdaoga → Arxan
cards.sub: Early autumn, north line first. The birches turn before Arxan does.

days.note: Two Rivers viewpoint, Moergele's river bends, Ergun wetland at dusk.
Genbai road, white birch all the way, reindeer park.
Old logging train, then the border river road: 9ka to 5ka.
Grassland, slide, horse ride at sunset. Sleep in a yurt.
Sheep feeding, then the city that looks like a stage set.
Hulun Lake, then the volcanic forest.
Morning fog on Wusu Langzi, forest park, drive out.

cards.foot: Offline maps. No signal out there.

cards.title: Wenzhou → Aojiang → Nanji
cards.sub: Sea meadows, blue water, and a very average hotel.

days.note: Train to Pingyang, 15 min to Aojiang pier, 2h ferry. Beach, sunset, seafood.
Sunrise on the meadow, rainbow road, boat back by noon.

cards.foot: Clear day only. Wind is real.

cards.title: Nianbadu → Jianglangshan
cards.sub: A living Ming-Qing town and a Danxia peak Xu Xiake climbed three times.

days.note: 3-4h. Bamboo bridge, tofu workshop, Wenchang Palace, East Rise bridge, echo wall.
3-4h loop: Kaiming temple → Huixian rock → Xiake pavilion → One Line Sky → summit.

cards.foot: 3h from Hangzhou by car.

cards.title: Hailar → Ergun → Moerdaoga → Manzhouli
cards.sub: Autumn gold on a budget, booked late and still cheap.

days.note: Zhalumude wetland, Moergele river, Ergun wetland (¥75 with bus).
Karting across the wetland, reindeer, forest train.
Taiping, Shenxian slope, border town. Sleep in Linjiang for the fog.
Horse ride at dusk, yurt, 180° sunset and stars.
Matryoshka square, windmill road, Hulun Lake, back.

cards.foot: Morning fog at Linjiang is the whole trip.

cards.title: Jinshan → Xijindu, on foot
cards.sub: A river town with a thousand years and no queue.

days.note: ¥60, 8:00-17:00. The temple that swallowed its own mountain.
Plane trees, Republican facades, old-town lunch.
Free, book ahead, closed Mondays. Former consulate building.
Free, open 24h. Stone street, old pagoda, lights on.

cards.foot: Pot-cover noodles + vinegar. Non-negotiable.

cards.title: Hangzhou → Pujiang → old villages
cards.sub: 30 minutes by train, a thousand years by foot.

days.note: Nine archways, Zheng ancestral hall, wood carvings. Then Songxi village.
Song pagoda, forest temple with cats, Ming-Qing courtyard houses.

cards.foot: No crowds. That's the point.

cards.title: Huangshan's quieter neighbour
cards.sub: Red cliffs, carved inscriptions, a village on the edge.

days.note: Arrive, wander, stay for the fish lanterns, fire show, sparks at night.
Cable car → Wangxian tower → Zhenxian cave → Moon Street → Yuxu Palace → summit → down.

cards.foot: Short loop exists. The long one is better.

cards.title: Yangjiatang → Songzhuang → Chenjiapu
cards.sub: Rain makes it better. Three villages, one road.

days.note: Gold earth walls stacked up the slope. ¥20 for the man and his cow.
Stream through the village, stepping stones, a bowl of noodles.
Cliff village in the cloud. Bookshop, coffee, nothing to do.

cards.foot: Wear grip. The steps are mossy.

cards.title: Lhasa → Everest's east face → Pulan
cards.sub: Built from satellite maps, not tour brochures.

days.note: Land, hotel, sleep. Stay near Barkhor.
Jokhang in the morning, Potala in the afternoon. Book ahead. No hair washing.
Skip the paid viewpoints, stop where locals park. Pumoyong Co, sleep at 4,500m.
Chongba Co, then the back road to Duina. Quden Nima glacier: take the high road.
Xilin viewpoint, Everest from the east, Pelkut Co, sleep in Gyirong town.
Naxia village at dawn, Gyibu canyon, Nepali lunch, drive on.
Jiwu temple, La'ang Co for Kailash, border market at Pulan.
Base camp, canal viewpoint on the 219, start the long way home.

cards.foot: Two days to acclimatise. Seriously.

cards.title: ¥2,700 for 30 days
cards.sub: Rent first, plans second. The cheap room is found on foot.

days.note: Village self-built room in Fengyangyi: water, wifi, own bathroom. Sunny days make the hot water forgivable.
Noodles ¥10-20, Bai meals ¥40-50, one big dinner a week. Coffee ¥5 or ¥17, your call.
Bus on the 214, ¥3 goes far. Taxis ¥10-20 when it rains.
Sunrise, lake loops, seagulls, free evening music. Dali is cheap if you stop buying views.

cards.foot: Short-let 5 nights, then commit.

cards.title: Budapest → Athens on ¥15,660
cards.sub: Dorms, night buses, one real meal a day.

days.note: Trains and buses. Buy a 72h transit pass, walk the rest.
Hostel in Kreuzberg. Museum island one day, nothing the next.
Night bus in, two nights, one long walk, one pizza.
Book Renfe early or take the bus. Tapas standing up is cheapest.
Tram 28 before 9am. Sardines for dinner, €3.
Fly in on a budget carrier. Acropolis at opening time.
Cheap return flight, one last thermal bath.

cards.foot: Pack earplugs. Dorms are loud.

cards.title: Xining to Lanzhou, both ends open
cards.sub: ~¥5,000. Slightly hard, entirely worth it.

days.note: Overnight train. Sleep, wake up at altitude.
Acclimatise. Butter lamps and cold air.
Erlangjian, then salt flats at sunset. Windproof everything.
Chaidamu salt lakes, Black Lone Mountain, long empty road.
Yang Pass, Yumen Pass, Yadan landforms. Bring water, no shade.
Caves in the morning, dunes at dusk. Night market after.
Pingshan Lake canyon. Get there early, colours change by noon.
Cliff monasteries, then a 3h train. Night market in Lanzhou.
Museum, bridge, beef noodles, plane.

cards.foot: Fuel up early. Stations are far apart.

cards.title: Chengdu → Siguniang
cards.sub: ¥2,500 each, no alarms, two shots at a golden summit.

days.note: Late flight, airport hotel. Pick up the car in the morning.
Drive, then Juli Temple ridge for sunset on the peaks.
Forest lake in the morning, another sunset attempt at 4,500m.
Grassland, monastery, then the long valley road.
One valley, all of western Sichuan's landforms. Then drive back and fly.

cards.foot: Oxygen in the boot. Sleep below 3,500m.

cards.title: 4,300 km of road and weather
cards.sub: ¥2,400 for two. ¥1,200 each. Not a holiday.

days.note: 430 km. Zheduo Pass is where 318 begins.
310 km. Eighteen bends, Litang, grassland, twin lakes.
150 km. Cross the Jinsha river, enter Tibet, roads narrow.
310 km. Dongda Pass, 72 turns. A truck closed the road for six hours.
220 km. Ranwu Lake, turquoise and cold.
230 km. Tongmai, Lulang, forest and rain.
400 km. Arrive at dusk and stop arguing with the trip.

cards.foot: Altitude is not negotiable.

cards.title: Four long-weekend routes
cards.sub: All free to drive. All with the sea on one side.

days.note: 168 km, 9 stops. Chongjia'ao tidal flats, Yandun sea watchtower, Longtai back, Yanting beach, Jinshan town.
Windmill tunnel, Fantong hill, Songlanshan beach, Dongdan village, Shipu old port, Hua'ao island.
Day 1 Songmen market, Shuitong'ao, Daken beach. Day 2 sunrise at Shitang, Xiaoruo village colours.
Kantou village, Meiganling terraces, Shangcun, Qingren falls, Yunshan ridge at 1,200m.

cards.foot: Go midweek. Every viewpoint is a car park.

cards.title: Hainan's best coast road
cards.sub: Day 1 windmills and temples, day 2 coconuts and old streets.

days.note: Windmill coast, Baohu Cape, Moon Bay, Foguang Temple by the sea, Stone Park.
Dongjiao coconut grove, sea library at Yilong Bay, old arcade streets of Wennan.

cards.foot: Sleep near Qishui Bay. Book early.

cards.title: Five night walks, 6pm to 10pm
cards.sub: Eat first. Then one of these. No taxis required.

days.note: Broken Bridge → Beishan Road → Gushan Road → Baidi. 3 km, plane trees, boat lights.
Dadou Road → Xiaohe park → Xiaohe old street. Stone slabs, cargo barges, warm lamps.
Light show 19:30 and 20:30, then walk the embankment west. Crowd thins after 21:00.
10 km, 1-1.5h on a shared bike. Beishan tunnel of trees, Yanggong causeway.
Southern Song imperial street → Hefang → Drum Tower. Snacks, lanterns, old shops.

cards.foot: Skip Hefang on weekends. Genuinely.

cards.title: Three days, zero wasted walks
cards.sub: Sun Yat-sen, a temple, a wall, a museum, and a lot of duck.

days.note: Wutong avenue → Meiling Palace → music stage → Sun Yat-sen mausoleum → Confucius Temple at night.
Jiming Temple → Taicheng wall → Xuanwu Lake → Avant-garde bookstore → Xinjiekou.
Nanjing Museum → Presidential Palace → Six Dynasties Museum → memorial → Kexiang for food.

cards.foot: Do not skip Kexiang. Do skip the tourist duck.

cards.title: The south line, done properly
cards.sub: 434 instead of 318 on day two. Oxygen in the car.

days.note: Pick up the car at Shuangliu, Luding bridge on the way. Sleep low.
Take the 434. Yuzixi or Moshi park, one of them, not both.
9-10h. Eighteen bends, Wuliang river, Hare mountain. Cash for toilets.
One hour bus to the trailhead. Motion sickness pills for the way back.
Twin lakes. Batang is small, Tibetan, worth an evening.
11h. Enter Tibet, Dongda Pass, 72 turns. Leave early.
Ranwu Lake. Then subtropical forest and oxygen you can breathe.
Lulang stone-pot chicken. Namcha Barwa if the sky opens.
4h. Museum in the afternoon, Barkhor at dusk.
Potala morning, Jokhang afternoon, souvenirs at Barkhor mall.

cards.foot: Book cancellable hotels. Weather wins.

cards.title: Yining → Sayram → Kanas
cards.sub: ¥3,200 each. Rent the car, skip the tour.

days.note: Fly in, stay on Six Star Street. Police at every corner, walkable at night.
2-3h drive. Ticket valid 24h. Loop once, sleep at the east gate.
Sunrise at Dianjiangtai around 8:20 in winter. Then 3.5h east.
5-6h. Park outside, take the little train. Two hours is plenty.
4h with livestock on the road. Border permit on the way. Wooden cabin facing the snow.
Shuttle from Baihaba, 1h. Only worth it in good weather.
Morning fog, walk to the old village for breakfast, drive out slowly.
Fly out. Total ¥3,200 each without flights.

cards.foot: Check the weather daily. Ili punishes optimists.

cards.title: Xiangshan coast loop
cards.sub: Windmills, fishing ports, volcanic rock. One tank of fuel.

days.note: 800 m of windmill road, the sea at the end of it.
Grass, cows, sea sunrise. Zhejiang's little Sayram.
Half mountain, half sea, fine sand.
Green, damp, slightly forgotten. Walk it slowly.
Where half the period dramas are shot. Skip unless curious.
A crescent bay under a cut-away hill. Low tide only.
600 years old. Free after 5pm. Fish smells honest.
Ferry across, then the biggest sand in the bay.
120 million year old volcanic columns and salt pans.

cards.foot: Two days. One is too rushed.

cards.title: Yining → Sayram → Kanas
cards.sub: Two women, no 6am starts, never more than 5h driving.

days.note: 5h flight. Six Star Street, walkable, police on every corner.
2-3h drive. Ticket valid 24h. Loop once, sleep at the east gate.
Sunrise at Dianjiangtai, around 8:20. Then 3.5h east.
Ghost city by little train, 5-6h total. Sleep in Burqin.
4h with livestock on the road. Border permit en route. Cabin facing snow.
Shuttle 1h. Only in good weather. Rain ruins it.
Morning fog, breakfast in the old village, slow drive out.

cards.foot: Check weather daily. Ili punishes optimists.

cards.title: Pick by days, not by photos
cards.sub: From hardcore gravel to lying on a beach.

days.note: High plateau wildlife, hot springs and border towns, Himalayan monasteries.
Longest prayer corridor, autumn grassland, spruce forests and horse herds.
China's loneliest road through Chaidamu; the highest road over Kekexili.
Hengduan mountains to Lhasa; surf, salt fields and rockets on one island.
120 km, all the drama of 318 with none of the altitude.
94 km from 2,000m to 3,600m; or 1,000 km of Shandong coast.

cards.foot: Book beds before the holiday, not during.

cards.title: Where the money went
cards.sub: 632,353 steps. ¥777 a day. No dorms, no regrets.

days.note: Business hotels near stations, about ¥255 a night. Cheap, clean, breakfast included.
JR Hokuriku arch pass + San'in pass ¥2,485, flights ¥1,925, the rest buses and metros.
¥138 a day: university canteens, supermarkets, gyudon, one proper meal a week.
Fridge magnets, souvenirs, a suitcase, a SIM. Nothing impulsive.
USJ, drift ice cruise, onsens, cable cars.

cards.foot: Thirty days is the sweet spot on a 3-year visa.

cards.title: Windmills, S-bends, empty sand
cards.sub: High-speed rail to Pingtan station, then a car.

days.note: Jingsha at low tide (check the tide table), then sunset on the big beach.
Tanshui swing, ecological corridor windmills, the S-bend, Maotouqian, Heping village at dusk.
Watch the sun from bed, then shells and sand before the train home.

cards.foot: North line early. Everyone has the same idea by 10am.

cards.title: The rules that made it work
cards.sub: No taxis. No hotels. One bag.

days.note: Chongqing → Guiyang → Yangshuo → Guilin → Liuzhou → Nanning → Beihai.
Guangzhou → Shunde → Shantou → Nan'ao → Dongshan → Xiamen → Quanzhou → Pingtan → Fuzhou.
Wenzhou → Shaoxing → Hangzhou → Wuzhen → Nanxun → Xitang → Suzhou → Nanjing.
Qingdao → Weihai → Yantai → Jinan → Tai'an → Tianjin → Beijing → Datong.
Hohhot → Ulanqab → Yinchuan → Zhongwei → Lanzhou → Chengdu → Jiuzhaigou → Chongqing.

cards.foot: Book the hostel, not the itinerary.

cards.title: A village built as a diagram
cards.sub: 700 years old, nine palaces and eight trigrams.

days.note: Breakfast first: egg pancake, meat dumpling, salty soy milk.
The yin-yang eye of the layout. Half well, half land.
Fat beams, carved brackets. Then the hilltop for the whole village.
Fish lanterns, Kongming lights, NPC skits in the lanes.

cards.foot: 1h from Jinhua station by car.

cards.title: Cliff temple and river town
cards.sub: Shouchang, Lingqi cave, Yanzhou, Daci Rock.

days.note: Lunch, then Lingqi cave. Stalagmites lit like a film set. 2h.
River wall, old gates, a hotel inside the old town.
Temple half built into the cliff. Cable car up, alpine slide down.

cards.foot: Go early. The cliff walkway queues.

cards.title: Lhasa → Nyima → Bangoin
cards.sub: Two oxygen tanks. One 9.5-hour day.

days.note: Skip paid viewpoints, stop where locals park.
Ten Thousand Dunes, Everest monument, Guandi temple.
Pelkut Co with Shishapangma behind it.
9.5h. Zari Namtso, Tangra Yumco. The long day.
Selin Co, the biggest lake in Tibet. 3.5h.

cards.foot: Sleep below 4,200m where you can.

cards.title: Gardens, alleys, breakfast
cards.sub: Small city, short distances, slow mornings.

days.note: Old shops, then Ge Garden. Bamboo, rockeries, four seasons in one courtyard.
Bookshops, the big YANGZHOU wall, Zhu Ziqing's house down a lane.
Restored merchant courtyards, coffee in a 200-year-old hall.
The performance is worth it. Sit near the water.

cards.foot: Eat breakfast twice. It's that good.

cards.title: Xining to Lanzhou, ¥2,900
cards.sub: Free viewpoints over paid ones.

days.note: Rest. Altitude first, sightseeing second.
South hill viewpoint free. Chaka at the last stop, not the first.
Salt lake, water Yadan, U-shaped road from the verge.
Emerald Lake gate 2, Black Lone Mountain, long drive.
Mogao with an A ticket. Dunes at 4:30pm.
Danxia north gate, platform 4 before sunset.
Grassland, Gangshika snow, back to Xining.
Noodles, museum, flight.

cards.foot: Book Mogao 30 days ahead.

cards.title: Fly Friday, hike Saturday
cards.sub: ¥1,000. Brutal and worth it.

days.note: 21:00 flight, airport hotel. Sleep 5 hours.
6am train, 8am bus, 2h on the ridge, boat to Wushan at 13:20.
Dragon ridge by headtorch, 2h up. Sleep on the mountain.
Cloud sea over the gorge, then the long way back.

cards.foot: Head torch. Real shoes.

cards.title: Never more than 3h driving
cards.sub: One driver. No alarms. Good beds.

days.note: Fly in, Six Star Street, supermarket snacks.
2h drive, loop once, sleep at the east gate.
4.5h via G219. Or the Yizhao road if the weather is kind.
Xiata in the morning, 20 km on foot, then 2.5h.
40 min then 2.5h. Grassland gradient all day.
3h. Valley walk in the morning, drive after lunch.
No driving. Sunset on the grass. Photo day.

cards.foot: Book Sayram and Nalati early.

cards.title: Land border in, land border out
cards.sub: Marshrutkas, guesthouses, bread and cheese.

days.note: Guesthouses and five nights camping. About ¥63 a night.
Shared taxis and minibuses. Tbilisi to Yerevan ¥30.
Eating out twice a day. Khachapuri is not cheap when it's every meal.
Tent, mat, wine. The tent paid for itself in five nights.

cards.foot: Carry cash outside the big cities.

cards.title: Xining → Dunhuang → Xining
cards.sub: A different colour every day.

days.note: City hotel. Sleep early.
Gangshika snow, Qilian grassland, Danxia at dusk.
Desert poplar forest, fortress from the road.
Earth's Son sculpture, Mingsha dunes, Crescent Lake.
Caves early, Black Lone Mountain, sleep at Lenghu.
Yadan at noon, U-shaped road, 227 km after.
Salt lake early, 300 km back.

cards.foot: One day, one colour. Don't rush it.

cards.title: 360 km, free, empty
cards.sub: Five segments or the app puts you on the highway.

days.note: 60 km. Red and orange rock layers, roadside pull-offs.
35 km. Jiangshan Duojiao viewpoint first. Free.
45 km. Turquoise water against red cliffs. Drone spot.
120 km. Best light after 6pm. Closes 21:30.
30 km. Sleep, fuel, tomorrow Sayram.

cards.foot: Navigate segment by segment.

cards.title: Small loop, no backtracking
cards.sub: Chengdu → Danba → Tagong → Kangding.

days.note: Pick up the car, drive the valley, sleep low.
Tibetan towers, river gorge, 2,000m.
Yala snow mountain, monastery, yak butter tea.
Photo heaven. Poplar, river, horses.
Zheduo Pass early, then home.

cards.foot: Altitude gains are gentle. Still drink water.

cards.title: Mangshi → Ruili → Tengchong
cards.sub: Border markets, hot springs, Dai food.

days.note: 1.5h. One Village Two Countries, Jiegao gate.
Dai palace, tropical forest, 2h drive. Hot sea at night.
Qiluo old town, volcano park. Best lane for souvenirs.
1.5h. Golden pagoda at 4pm, silver pagoda at sunset.
Market, noodles, temple, flight out.

cards.foot: Skip the roadside jade shops.

cards.title: High, cold, very quiet
cards.sub: Sleep at 3,900m, not 4,700m.

days.note: Yamdrok south line, Karola glacier. 5.5h.
Selin Co viewpoint, 3h. 4,700m, oxygen hotel.
Via Nagqu. Stock up, no big towns after.
2h. Inner-lake guesthouse, butter tea, thin air.
6h back. Or retreat to Biru if altitude bites.
7.5h on G349. Drop the car, walk Barkhor.

cards.foot: 87 km/h got me a fine. Watch the cameras.

cards.title: G219 + G331 + G228
cards.sub: Start and finish at Dongxing. 80-120 days.

days.note: 10,065 km. Guangxi, Yunnan, Tibet, Xinjiang. The hardest and the best.
9,300 km. Altai, Hulunbuir, Mohe, Changbai. Autumn is the season.
7,800 km. Four seas, every fishing port, the whole coast.

cards.foot: Permits for Xinjiang, Tibet, Yunnan borders.

cards.title: Nanchang → lake → rice fields
cards.sub: No entrance fee. Bring a car.

days.note: A lake island with a car park. Blue water when the weather behaves.
Grassland this way. Green as a cartoon, empty as a Monday.
Camphor avenue, golden rice, sunset. Stay until the light goes.

cards.foot: Check water levels before you go.

cards.title: One year of weekend routes
cards.sub: Bamboo, canyons, coast, sky roads.

days.note: Bamboo forest, guesthouses, coffee. Busy on weekends.
Shallow water, old villages, almost no cars.
Free, no ticket, gorge and stream the whole way.
Flat, shallow, kid-safe. Free.
Sea of clouds at the top, East China Sea below.
Mountain on one side, sea on the other, empty tarmac.
Mountain driving and swimming holes in the same afternoon.
Highest paved road in Zhejiang. Free terraces.

cards.foot: Midweek, always midweek.

cards.title: Free meadow, free parking
cards.sub: One hour from Hangzhou. Dogs allowed.

days.note: Ancient city ruins park. No gate, no ticket, no queue.
Mat, book, thermos. Sunset around 18:30 in autumn.
Stars if the sky is clear, silence if it isn't.

cards.foot: Bring mosquito repellent. Really.

cards.title: Kiln town and bamboo train
cards.sub: 2h from Hangzhou by car.

days.note: Through bamboo and tea fields. Slow on purpose.
Pottery workshops, kiln museums, one good coffee.
258 raptors circling. Sit down and stop talking.
20:00. Get there 20 minutes early for the front.

cards.foot: Sleep at the kiln hotel.
